summary.text: One of the twelve suitors from Ithaca in Apollodorus' catalogue — a homonym distinct from Promachus son of Parthenopaeus among the Epigoni, Jason's infant brother slain by Pelias, and the Boeotian namesake at Troy.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Promachus among the twelve wooers specifically from Ithaca itself, named alongside Antinous, Pronous, Liodes, Eurynomus, Amphimachus, Amphialus, Amphimedon, Aristratus, Helenus, Dulicheus, and Ctesippus.
